snp5.11:1.1: “For those standing in the middle of a lake, said venerable Kappa,
snp5.11:1.3: when a fearful flood has arisen,
snp5.11:1.4: for those overcome by old age and death, speak (about) an island, dear Sir,
snp5.11:1.6: you must explain an island to me, so there will be no more after this.”
snp5.11:2.1: “For those standing in the middle of a lake, Kappa, said the Fortunate One,
snp5.11:2.3: when a fearful flood has arisen,
snp5.11:2.5: for those overcome by old age and death, I speak (about) an island, Kappa:
snp5.11:3.1: having nothing, no attachment, this is the island with nothing beyond,
snp5.11:3.4: this is called Nibbāna, I say, the end of old age and death.
snp5.11:4.2: Knowing this, those who are mindful, who are emancipated in this very life,
snp5.11:4.4: come not under Māra’s control, they are not servants to Māra.”
